mandatory_repairs: Make adapters emit lossless local records while the runtime alone owns envelope construction, snapshot identity, and publication.
Use invariant runtime_authority_effect none and preserve source-owned authority axes only as local facets or opaque payload.
Separate human aliases, predicates, branches, statuses, and lifecycle values into owner-bound axis-qualified facets.
Separate runtime execution status from native validation result and every conformance or authority claim.
Require both confidence axes with provenance wherever confidence is emitted; reject scalar confidence.
